subject: Q3 budget planning kickoff
bodyPreview: Hi team, we are kicking off FY27 Q3 budget planning. Please send me your department's headcount plan and projected cloud spend by October 2. Finance will consolidate everything int
bodyText:
Hi team, we are kicking off FY27 Q3 budget planning. Please send me your department's headcount plan and projected cloud spend by October 2. Finance will consolidate everything into the Q3 budget plan and review it with Olivia in mid October.

A template is in the Finance site under Budget Planning. Let me know if anything is unclear.

subject: RE: Q3 budget planning kickoff
bodyPreview: Hi Priya, Engineering's submission for Q3: cloud spend of $1.84M (up 9% because of Project Atlas load testing and the new EU region) and six net-new engineering hires. The detail i
bodyText: Hi Priya, Engineering's submission for Q3: cloud spend of $1.84M (up 9% because of Project Atlas load testing and the new EU region) and six net-new engineering hires. The detail is in the template on the Finance site. Happy to walk through the assumptions.

subject: Q3 budget: cloud cost variance
bodyPreview: Akshay, the cloud spend variance report is attached. Platform is running 12% over the planned run-rate, mostly from the auth service autoscaling and test environments that were lef
bodyText: Akshay, the cloud spend variance report is attached. Platform is running 12% over the planned run-rate, mostly from the auth service autoscaling and test environments that were left on. Can you and Liam explain the overage before the review meeting?

subject: Q3 budget review: meeting notes and decisions
bodyPreview: Thanks all for the review today. Decisions: (1) Engineering headcount capped at 5 new hires for Q3, the sixth is deferred to Q4; (2) cloud spend increase approved at 7% with a mont
bodyText: Thanks all for the review today. Decisions: (1) Engineering headcount capped at 5 new hires for Q3, the sixth is deferred to Q4; (2) cloud spend increase approved at 7% with a monthly checkpoint; (3) Atlas launch marketing budget stays at $420K. Priya will circulate draft v2 next week.

subject: Q3 budget: draft v2 with your comments
bodyPreview: Hi Akshay, draft v2 of the Q3 budget plan is attached and reflects the decisions from the review. Engineering total is now $11.6M including 5 hires. Please confirm the cloud assump
bodyText: Hi Akshay, draft v2 of the Q3 budget plan is attached and reflects the decisions from the review. Engineering total is now $11.6M including 5 hires. Please confirm the cloud assumptions by Friday.

subject: ACTION REQUIRED: Q3 budget final approval by Friday
bodyPreview: Akshay, I need Engineering's final sign-off on the Q3 budget by end of day Friday so we can lock the plan with the board pack. The final workbook and the approval memo are attached
bodyText: Akshay, I need Engineering's final sign-off on the Q3 budget by end of day Friday so we can lock the plan with the board pack. The final workbook and the approval memo are attached. If anything is off, tell Priya today.

subject: Q3 budget: engineering sign-off questions
bodyPreview: Priya, Olivia, before I sign off I have two questions on the final Q3 budget: why the Atlas load-testing environment is booked under Platform instead of Atlas, and whether the defe
bodyText: Priya, Olivia, before I sign off I have two questions on the final Q3 budget: why the Atlas load-testing environment is booked under Platform instead of Atlas, and whether the deferred sixth hire carries into Q4. Once confirmed I will approve.

subject: Project Atlas: launch plan and milestones
bodyPreview: Team, Project Atlas is our top priority this half. Milestones: private preview (done by Oct 20), beta readiness review (Nov 5), go/no-go (Nov 26) and general availability on Dec 3.
bodyText: Team, Project Atlas is our top priority this half. Milestones: private preview (done by Oct 20), beta readiness review (Nov 5), go/no-go (Nov 26) and general availability on Dec 3. Akshay owns the program, David the technical delivery, Marcus the go-to-market. The launch plan document is on the Atlas Program site.

subject: Atlas launch messaging draft
bodyPreview: Akshay, attached is the first draft of the Atlas messaging: positioning, three key value props and the press release outline. Fatima is working on the landing page visuals. Feedbac
bodyText: Akshay, attached is the first draft of the Atlas messaging: positioning, three key value props and the press release outline. Fatima is working on the landing page visuals. Feedback welcome by Wednesday.

subject: Atlas beta readiness: open P1 bugs
bodyPreview: Status for the beta readiness review: 7 open P1 bugs, down from 15. The remaining ones are in tenant onboarding and the export API. Kenji's team has a regression pass scheduled thi
bodyText: Status for the beta readiness review: 7 open P1 bugs, down from 15. The remaining ones are in tenant onboarding and the export API. Kenji's team has a regression pass scheduled this week. I think we can close the P1s before the review, but the export API fix is risky.

subject: Atlas launch checklist and owners
bodyPreview: Hi all, I have consolidated the Atlas launch checklist and assigned owners: messaging (Marcus), pricing sheet (Marcus and Priya Sharma), beta bugs (David), QA sign-off (Kenji), cus
bodyText: Hi all, I have consolidated the Atlas launch checklist and assigned owners: messaging (Marcus), pricing sheet (Marcus and Priya Sharma), beta bugs (David), QA sign-off (Kenji), customer comms (Grace). Please update your rows in the launch plan by Friday.

subject: Customer feedback from Atlas private preview
bodyPreview: Summary of feedback from 9 private preview customers is attached. Top themes: the onboarding flow is great, export is slow for large tenants, and customers want SSO sooner. Northwi
bodyText: Summary of feedback from 9 private preview customers is attached. Top themes: the onboarding flow is great, export is slow for large tenants, and customers want SSO sooner. Northwind asked about pricing for the enterprise tier.

subject: Atlas GA go/no-go criteria
bodyPreview: Proposed go/no-go criteria for Atlas GA: zero open P1s, fewer than 10 P2s, p95 API latency under 400 ms in the load test, and a successful failover drill. The criteria document is
bodyText: Proposed go/no-go criteria for Atlas GA: zero open P1s, fewer than 10 P2s, p95 API latency under 400 ms in the load test, and a successful failover drill. The criteria document is in the Atlas Program site. Please review before the go/no-go meeting.

subject: Atlas launch event: Nov 19 run of show
bodyPreview: Attached is the run of show for the Atlas customer launch event on November 19. Akshay, you have a 10-minute slot on the program journey; David presents the architecture demo. Plea
bodyText: Attached is the run of show for the Atlas customer launch event on November 19. Akshay, you have a 10-minute slot on the program journey; David presents the architecture demo. Please send slides by Monday.

subject: Atlas GA date moved to Dec 3?
bodyPreview: Heads up: the export API fix slipped and I want to flag the risk to the Dec 3 GA date. If the fix lands by Nov 24 we keep the date; otherwise I recommend moving GA by one week. I n
bodyText: Heads up: the export API fix slipped and I want to flag the risk to the Dec 3 GA date. If the fix lands by Nov 24 we keep the date; otherwise I recommend moving GA by one week. I need a decision at the go/no-go meeting.

subject: Atlas launch comms: customer email timing
bodyPreview: Marcus, Grace, proposal for the Atlas customer email: send the heads-up on Nov 17 and the launch announcement on GA day. If David confirms the GA date slips, we hold the announceme
bodyText: Marcus, Grace, proposal for the Atlas customer email: send the heads-up on Nov 17 and the launch announcement on GA day. If David confirms the GA date slips, we hold the announcement until the date is final.

subject: [SEV1] Auth service outage - initial notice
bodyPreview: We are investigating a Sev1 outage of the authentication service starting 05:12 UTC on Oct 14. Users cannot sign in to Contoso Cloud and Atlas preview tenants. Incident commander i
bodyText: We are investigating a Sev1 outage of the authentication service starting 05:12 UTC on Oct 14. Users cannot sign in to Contoso Cloud and Atlas preview tenants. Incident commander is Sarah Chen. A bridge is open in the incident-response channel. Next update in 30 minutes.

subject: [SEV1] Resolved: Auth service restored
bodyPreview: The auth service outage is resolved as of 08:47 UTC after about 3 hours 35 minutes. Root cause was an expired certificate on the token signing service combined with a failed automa
bodyText: The auth service outage is resolved as of 08:47 UTC after about 3 hours 35 minutes. Root cause was an expired certificate on the token signing service combined with a failed automatic rotation. A postmortem will follow within 5 business days.

subject: Postmortem owner and timeline
bodyPreview: Sarah will own the postmortem for the Oct 14 auth outage, Liam owns the action items. Draft due Oct 21, review meeting the week after. Please keep it blameless and include customer
bodyText: Sarah will own the postmortem for the Oct 14 auth outage, Liam owns the action items. Draft due Oct 21, review meeting the week after. Please keep it blameless and include customer impact numbers.

subject: Draft postmortem: Auth outage Oct 14
bodyPreview: Draft postmortem attached. Summary: 3h35m outage, about 18,000 failed sign-ins, 41 enterprise tenants affected. Root cause: certificate rotation job failed silently, expiry alert w
bodyText: Draft postmortem attached. Summary: 3h35m outage, about 18,000 failed sign-ins, 41 enterprise tenants affected. Root cause: certificate rotation job failed silently, expiry alert was routed to a retired mailbox. Action items are listed in section 6. Comments welcome.

subject: Postmortem action items: status
bodyPreview: Status of the 8 postmortem action items: 3 done (alert routing fixed, certificate inventory, runbook update), 4 in progress, 1 not started (automated rotation canary). Tracker atta
bodyText: Status of the 8 postmortem action items: 3 done (alert routing fixed, certificate inventory, runbook update), 4 in progress, 1 not started (automated rotation canary). Tracker attached. The failover drill is the biggest remaining item.

subject: Postmortem review: exec summary feedback
bodyPreview: Thanks for the thorough postmortem. For the exec summary I would like clearer customer impact language and a one-line statement on what changes so this cannot happen again. Please
bodyText: Thanks for the thorough postmortem. For the exec summary I would like clearer customer impact language and a one-line statement on what changes so this cannot happen again. Please also add the cost of service credits. Let's close this out before the all-hands.

subject: Follow-up: failover drill scheduled
bodyPreview: The auth failover drill is scheduled for Nov 18 at 10:00 UTC. We will fail over the primary region and measure recovery time against the 15-minute target. It is also an Atlas go/no
bodyText: The auth failover drill is scheduled for Nov 18 at 10:00 UTC. We will fail over the primary region and measure recovery time against the 15-minute target. It is also an Atlas go/no-go criterion, so I would like you at the debrief.

subject: Hiring plan: 6 engineering reqs approved
bodyPreview: Good news: six engineering requisitions for FY27 are approved in the hiring plan: 3 Senior Backend Engineers, 2 SREs and 1 QA Engineer. Priya Nair from Talent Acquisition will run
bodyText: Good news: six engineering requisitions for FY27 are approved in the hiring plan: 3 Senior Backend Engineers, 2 SREs and 1 QA Engineer. Priya Nair from Talent Acquisition will run sourcing. Please finalize job descriptions this month.

bodyText: Hi Akshay, I have shortlisted 5 candidates for the Senior Backend Engineer role. Profiles are attached. Could you nominate an interview panel? I suggest David, Liam and yourself.

bodyText: Priya, Nina, my feedback on the SRE job description: add on-call expectations explicitly, mention experience with certificate and secrets management (relevant after the outage), and drop the requirement for a specific cloud certification.

bodyText: I have reviewed the cloud provider commitment contract. Key points: a 3-year spend commitment of $5.2M with a 10% shortfall penalty, and auto-renewal with a 90-day notice. I recommend negotiating the notice period. Redlines are attached.
